name: Take a Screenshot of the OpenBCI GUI Using Expert Mode
description:
The OpenBCI GUI is running an active Synthetic EEG session with Expert Mode already enabled. In Expert Mode, a screenshot keyboard shortcut is available that saves the current GUI view to disk.

Your task is to save a screenshot of the current OpenBCI GUI state:

1. Expert Mode is already active (note: there is no visible on-screen indicator for Expert Mode in OpenBCI GUI v5.2.2, but it has been pre-enabled for this task).
2. Click somewhere on the main GUI visualization area (Time Series widget or any data display area) to ensure the GUI has keyboard focus.
3. Press the 'm' key — this is the Expert Mode screenshot shortcut. It saves the current GUI view to disk.
4. A screenshot file will be saved automatically to the ~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/ folder.

After completing this task, a new screenshot file should exist in ~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/ with a timestamp in its filename.
